verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              कथयित्वा च तत्सर्वं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः स भारत। प्रययौ हिमवत्पार्श्वं ततो वज्रधरात्मजः॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata, the son of the wielder of thunder (Indra), having narrated everything to the Brahmanas, started for the side of the Himalayas.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यवटमासाद्य वसिष्ठस्य च पर्वतम्। भृगुतुङ्गे च कौन्तेयः कृतवाञ्शौचमात्मनः॥२॥
verses.english: Arriving first at Agastya Vata, the son of Kunti, then went to the Vasishtha's hill. On the peak of Bhrigu hill he performed his ablutions.

verses.sanskrit: प्रददौ गोसहस्राणि सुबहूनि च भारत। निवेशांश्च द्विजातिभ्यः सोऽददत्कुरुसत्तमः॥३॥
verses.english: descendant of Bharata, the best of the Kurus gave away to many Brahmanas thousands of king and houses.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यबिन्दोस्तीर्थे च स्नात्वा पुरुषसत्तमः। दृष्टवान्पाण्डवश्रेष्ठः पुण्यान्यायतनानि च॥४॥
verses.english: That best of then bathed at the pilgrimage, named, Hiranyabindu and then that best of Pandavas went to many other sacred pieces.

verses.sanskrit: अवतीर्य नरश्रेष्ठो ब्राह्मणैः सह भारत। प्राचीं दिशमभिप्रेप्सुर्जगाम भरतर्षभः॥५॥
verses.english: O best of Bharata race, that best of men accompanied by the Brahmanas then descended (form those hills) and the countries situated in that direction,

verses.sanskrit: आनुपूर्व्येण तीर्थानि दृष्टवान्कुरुसत्तमः। नदीं चोत्पलिनीं रम्यामरण्यं नैमिषं प्रति॥६॥
verses.english: The best of the Kurus saw the pilgrimages one after the other. O descendant of Bharata, he saw the river Utpalasa in the forest of Naimisha: (he saw) the Nanda, the Upananda, the famous Kaushika, the great rivers Gaya and Ganga and other Tirthas and hermitages where he purified himself and gave away to the Brahmanas (many) kine.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दामपरनन्दां च कौशिकीं च यशस्विनीम्। महानदीं गयां चैव गङ्गामपि च भारत॥७॥
एवं तीर्थानि सर्वाणि पश्यमानस्तथाश्रमान्। आत्मनः पावनं कुर्वन्ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ च गाः॥८॥
अङ्गवङ्गकलिङ्गेषु यानि तीर्थानि कानिचित्। जगाम तानि सर्वाणि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च॥९॥
verses.english: Whatever Tirthas and other holy places were in Anga, Vanga and Kalinga, he went to all of them.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा च विधिवत्तानि धनं चापि ददौ ततः। कलिङ्गराष्ट्रद्वारेषु ब्राह्मणाः पाण्डवानुगाः। अभ्यनुज्ञाय कौन्तेयमुपावर्तन्त भारत॥१०॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, seeing them all and performing many ceremonies and giving away much wealth, he went to the gate of the kingdom of Kalinga where the Brahmanas, who were following him, bade the son of Kunti farewell and desisted from following him any further.

verses.sanskrit: स तु तैरभ्यनुज्ञातः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनञ्जयः। सहायैरल्पकैः शूरः प्रययौ यत्र सागरः॥११॥
verses.english: Having obtained their leave, the son of Kunti, the brave Dhananjaya, accompanied by only a few attendants, went there where the was.

verses.sanskrit: स कलिङ्गानतिक्रम्य देशानायतनानि च। हर्म्याणि रमणीयानि प्रेक्षणाणो ययौ प्रभुः॥१२॥
verses.english: Crossing (the country of the Kalingas and seeing on his way many countries, holy places and charming mansions, that lord preceded on.

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रपर्वतं दृष्ट्वा तापसैरुपशोभितम्। समुद्रतीरेण शनैर्मणिपूरं जगाम ह॥१३॥
verses.english: Seeing the Mahendra mountain adorned with the ascetics and going slowly along the sea-shores, he went to Manipur.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वाणि तीर्थानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च। अभिगम्य महाबाहुरभ्यगच्छन्महीपतिम्॥१४॥
verses.english: O king seeing all Tirthas and other holy places, the mighty-armed hero went.

verses.sanskrit: मणपूरेश्वरं राजन्धर्मज्ञं चित्रवाहनम्। तस्य चित्राङ्गदा नाम दुहिता चारुदर्शना॥१५॥
verses.english: To the king of Manipur, the virtuous Chitravahana, who had a beautiful daughter named Chitrangada.

verses.sanskrit: तां ददर्श पुरे तस्मिन्विचरन्तीं यदृच्छया। दृष्ट्वा च तां वरारोहां चकमे चैत्रवाहनीम्॥१६॥
verses.english: He saw her in capital roaming at pleasure. Seeing the handsome of Chitravahana, he was filled with desire.

verses.sanskrit: अभिगम्य च राजानमवदत्स्वं प्रयोजनम्। देहि मे खल्विमां राजन्क्षत्रियाय महात्मने॥१७॥
verses.english: Going to the king, he told him what he desired, saying, “O king, give your daughter to son of an illustrious Kshatriya.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा त्वब्रवीद्राजा कस्य पुत्रोऽसि नाम किम्। उवाच तं पाण्डवोहं कुन्तीपुत्रो धनञ्जयः॥१८॥
verses.english: Having heard this, the king said “Whose son are you and what is your name?" He (Arjuna) replied, “I am the Pandava, the son of Kunti, Dhananjaya".

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाचाथ राजा स सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वचः। राजा प्रभञ्जनो नाम कुलेऽस्मिन्संबभूव ह॥१९॥
verses.english: The king then spoke thus in sweet accents, "There was born a king in our race named Prabhanjana.

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रः प्रसवेनार्थी तपस्तेपे स उत्तमम्। उग्रेण तपसा तेन देवदेवः पिनाकधृक्॥२०॥
verses.english: He was childless. In order to get a child he performed excellent penances. By his severe austerities, the god of gods, the wielder of Pinaka (Shiva). The supreme lord the god of gods and the husband of Uma, O Partha, was gratificd. The illustrious Deity gave him the boon that only one child would be born in our race (in succession).

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरस्तोषितः पार्थ देवदेवः उमापतिः। स तस्मै भघवान्प्रादादेकैकं प्रसवं कुले॥२१॥
एकैकः प्रसवस्तस्माद्भवत्यस्मिन्कुले सदा। तेषां कुमाराः सर्वेषां पूर्वेषां मम जज्ञिरे॥२२॥
verses.english: Thence only one child is born to every successive descendant of race. All my ancestors had each a male child. But I have only a daughter to perpetuate my race. O best of men, I always consider her as my son.

verses.sanskrit: एका च मम कन्येयं कुलस्योत्पादिनी भृशम्। पुत्रो ममायमिति मे भावना पुरुषर्षभ॥२३॥
पुत्रिका हेतुविधिना संज्ञिता भरतर्षभ। तस्मादेकः सुतो योऽस्यां जायते भारत त्वया॥२४॥
verses.english: O best of the Bharata race, I have made her a Putrika (heir). O descendant of Bharata, the one son that will be born to her will be the perpetuator of my race. That son will be the dower in this marriage. O Pandava, you can take her if you like on this condition.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छुल्कं भवत्वस्याः कुलकृज्जायतामिह। एतेन समयेनेमां प्रतिगृह्णीष्व पाण्डव॥२५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: हेतुविधिना पुत्रहेतौ । पुत्रिकायामपि पुत्रशब्दप्रयोगविधानात् । लाङ्गलं जीवनमितिवत् तथा च लिङ्गं पुमांस एव मे पुत्रा जायेरन्निति । तेन पुत्र्यपि पुत्रसंज्ञिता ॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय तां कन्यां प्रतिगृह्य च। उवास नगरे तस्मिंस्तिस्रः कुन्तीसुतः समाः॥२६॥
verses.english: Promising to he accepted that maiden and the son of Kunti lived in that city for three years.
verses.bhavadeepa: शुल्कं मौल्यम् । अद्यापि पुत्रिकापुत्रस्यैव राज्यमिति दक्षिणकेरलेष्वाचारो दृश्यते ॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां सुते समुत्पन्ने परिष्वज्य वराङ्गनाम्। आमन्त्र्य नृपतिं तं तु जगाम परिवर्तितुम्॥२७॥
verses.english: When she gave birth to a son, he (Arjuna) embraced her with affection and taking leave of the king, he set out again in his travels.
verses.bhavadeepa: समाः वर्षाणि । हिमा इति पाठेपि हेमन्तत्रयेण स एवार्थे लक्ष्यः ।  पश्येम त्वा शतं हिम इति वेदे प्रयोगाच्च ॥२६॥
